results.portable_execution: Initial44 passed and24 setup errors exposed two missing dynamically imported public guard dependencies. Added their byte-identical closure and reran only the affected24; all passed. Unchanged44 were not repeated.

new_focused_probe.method: Naive explicit component-by-destination-width Fraction enumeration compared with factored trusted arithmetic helpers.

review_conclusions: Every consumed extensive source quantity has independent qualification. An unqualified positive field makes its complete affected total/density unavailable rather than zero; qualified subtotals remain separately labeled.
Group areas count declared physical geometry once, including zero-initial slots. Width/current/fullface/patchstate conventions agree with their explicit output definitions.

Represented extensive quantities already include the original canonical float patch area and are not multiplied by area again; exact geometric density areas retain separate signed canonical-area residuals.

Matched width applies exact geometric width fractions to each original quantity mixture. Non-width groups remain unchanged; patch-state reductions preserve their current/state base without a component-by-width materialization.
Available source sums and float projections are distinct: positive exact subnormal fractions, coarse display rounding and aggregate overflow retain rational values and signed projection errors.
Structural zero groups remain complete zeros over a positive declared area and cannot be confused with missing positive contributors.
Full-wall-minus-parts and translation-minus-count-times2kBT residuals have independent required-field availability and retain signed differences without balancing repair.
Rate activation energy is not added to the supplied source energy debit; gas internal energy, removal cost and translation remain distinct declared energy pathways.
Canonical source and cached scalar field validation are replayed by the public implementation before grouping; this reviewer inspected that route without calling it.
scope_clarifications: include_components=False returns a budget summary; full conditional time/temperature sampling requires the original conditioned source or included component manifests.
The unqualified contributor catalog covers the five consumed extensive quantities. Other source quantities remain in included component manifests or the original source.
The ledger does not expose a conditional-energy-per-parent ratio; any downstream ratio is undefined at zero count.
limits: Read-only scientific/numerical code review plus one new trusted-helper probe; not an end-to-end public source validation test.
The implementation owner independently tests fresh canonical source fixtures; reviewer did not rerun those tests.
The numerical fixtures are manufactured and do not represent water material/chemical parameters or an experimental source.
No host transaction, wall feedback, transport, collision, radiation, photon gate, FLASH/Quark run or physical spectrum is performed.
Completion applies to the exact reviewed code hash; later changes need a scoped review update.

packet_wrapper_review.scope: Independent read-only review of the new saved-packet source-ledger wrapper and its new tests. No public edits, old suite replay, packet sampling, source evolution, or source-moment recomputation was performed by this review.

initial_review_version.qualification: Initial expected-budget computation had no identified numerical blocker. The two closed findings below concerned metadata type admission and the precision enforced by one energy assertion. Initial artifacts remain associated with their initial wrapper rather than being relabelled as final-guard outputs.

closed_findings.subject: Nested JSON boolean/numeric aliases in inherited packet admission
closed_findings.initial_finding: The reused admission helper compared saved nested source manifests and NPZ scalar metadata with ordinary Python equality, allowing True/1 and False/0 aliases. Reconstructed ledger inputs remained canonical, but exact saved-metadata type replay was weaker than the new fixed-window exporter.
closed_findings.resolution: The new wrapper now uses shared type-sensitive same_json to compare packet_report.conditioned_source and packet_report.packets.source against the canonical source manifest. It separately reopens the NPZ with allow_pickle=False, decodes only metadata_json, and compares the complete decoded record type-sensitively against packet_report.packets. No old admission module or sampled array generation was changed.
closed_findings.verification: Three new regressions independently replace a canonical qualified=True field with integer1 in each report source manifest and in NPZ metadata_json, rebinding the affected file hash. All three reject through the new typed guard.

closed_findings.subject: Default absolute tolerance weakened the analytic energy assertion
closed_findings.initial_finding: pytest.approx(value, rel=3e-13) retained the default absolute1e-12 tolerance for source energies of order1e-7J, so the requested relative precision was not fully enforced.
closed_findings.resolution: The analytic count and five-channel energy comparison now explicitly uses abs=0.
closed_findings.verification: The affected normal export/analytic test passed again with the stricter tolerance, alongside the three new typed-admission tests.

assessments.shared_csv: The wrapper reuses write_ledger_csv from the new fixed-window exporter. Complete source availability, independent SI projection flags, qualified subtotals, per-area values and unqualified contributor references remain separate. The composite selection has blank global-window columns; no photon gate or invented global window is inferred.
assessments.original_and_copied_input_rechecks: The inherited helper binds exactly the expected local filenames and original report bytes. Before ledger calculation and again after output writing, the wrapper uses regular_file plus SHA256 to reject missing, indirect or changed inputs. The copied packet_export files are independently rechecked against the same hashes. Original report.json is included in this final check.
assessments.code_pins: pin_implementation unions the wrapper/core graph with producer, admission and shared-writer code lists, then verifies the complete selected map before staged publication. Code pins remain selected numerical module associations rather than every eager legacy package import, as disclosed in the report and documentation.
assessments.saved_source_admission: Admission verifies producer pins, exact report/config/source associations, declared status/provenance, the canonical HDF source and original local source selections. NPZ access uses allow_pickle=False, exact array names, shape/dtype/finiteness checks and source geometry checks. The final wrapper closes inherited nested JSON type aliases without recomputing saved random realizations.
assessments.source_expectation_vs_packet_realization: The new ledger reduces the reconstructed conditioned source, independently of saved particle velocities or sampled energy fluctuations. Expected outgoing translation uses2kBT, and supplied internal excitation and adsorbate-to-gas removal costs remain separate. Original mass declarations are retained as provenance and do not alter this expected energy budget. The report explicitly distinguishes deterministic source budgets from sampled packet energy, uncertainty and host acceptance.
assessments.publication_and_rollback: Existing files, directories and dangling output symlinks are refused. New files are staged beneath the output parent; original/copy rechecks and final implementation comparison precede ordinary rename. Late mutation and partial-write failures leave no new destination. This is a coordinated-single-writer protocol rather than a concurrent transaction guarantee.
assessments.documentation: The final documentation accurately describes source qualification versus projection, unique physical support areas, width-only redistribution, composite source selections, saved realization preservation, selected numerical pins, and the absence of source/packet regeneration or host acceptance. The final two-line clarification correctly limits the unqualified-contributor catalog to the five consumed extensive fields; original areal-quantity diagnostics remain in optional component source_window manifests.

verification_evidence.initial_new_tests: The initial10 new wrapper tests passed in the reported first run; the review did not repeat them.
verification_evidence.affected_new_tests: Three new typed-admission regressions plus the affected stricter normal analytic export passed. There are13 unique new test cases covered across the initial and targeted runs.

saved_study_review.matched_width_controls: independent direct per-component exact dx/full_width redistribution agrees with factored current/state bases and every reported group; original time/state/temperature/cost components remain associated
saved_study_review.closure_controls: exact extensive and area-weighted partition sums agree; supplied wall-minus-translation/internal/binding residuals retain their signs and values without repair
limitations: Every input is preserved manufactured generic-pool source evidence; no physical water calibration, transport, spectra or host budget acceptance is established.

The saved study has no unqualified extensive contributors. Preservation of unavailable contributors is checked structurally here; separate implementation evidence covers unsupported representation ranges.
Internal, binding/removal and full-wall channels are new analysis of already saved source quantities; prior profiles only provided number and translation comparisons.

The first independent prior-profile comparison exited zero with all1296 numerical checks passed and an unclosed-CSV ResourceWarning. Its exact script and log remain preserved; I/O alone was corrected and a new closed-file lifetime check passed, without repeating the unchanged numerical checks.

energy_channel_table.normalization: Any eV ratio is total declared deterministic source energy divided by the declared released source-parent count and the SI eV conversion; not a photon, electron, daughter-species, rovibrational or experimental yield normalization.

review_conclusions: All consumed source qualification/structural-zero flags, logarithms and component associations are retained through typed JSON comparison with the preserved original conditioned source.
All five extensive channels match independent sums in total, width, current, exact state, reservoir, original selection and patch-state groups.
Group densities use their unique full declared geometry once; canonical-minus-geometric signed area residuals remain separate.
Naive component-to-destination-width enumeration matches the factored matched-width groups and current/state bases, including non-width invariance.
Signed full-wall-minus-translation-minus-internal-minus-removal and translation-minus-count-times2kBT residuals match the original represented component fields without repair.
The original state-A zero internal cost remains complete structural zero, while state-B positive internal cost remains a positive complete quantity.
All exported CSV amounts, density values, availability and projection flags match authoritative ledger JSON.
Final ledger JSON and CSV are byte-identical to the initial export; typed admission changes affect validation and code/report pins, not ledger values.
limits: This is a new saved two-pool/two-state positive-internal-energy qualification, complementary to the separate one-pool zero-internal-cost study.
Only standard-library JSON/CSV/Fraction arithmetic and byte hashing are used; no ledger/source/reducer/owned solver calls occur.
Budgets and any eV-per-parent ratios refer to manufactured declared source parents. They do not establish molecular level assignment, photon normalization, daughter yields or experimental spectra.
Expected source translation remains separate from the saved packet realization and its sampling uncertainty.
No host transaction, physical water/material parameter, wall feedback, transport or radiation claim is made.
The completion is tied to exact code/artifact hashes.
Expected source parent budgets with supplied independent energy references; no physical water calibration or inferred state branching.
Kinetic activation barriers are separate from the supplied removal energy and are not added to the wall total.
Source translation means are distinct from realized particle energies and their conditional thermal scatter.
Signed wall-minus-parts residuals are retained; stacked height and marker are floating-point display projections.
